fields.statement: At 6204d340: go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks/... passes. make self-check reports no docs-commands finding (no unknown rhiza command in README.md or docs/); its only failures are stale .rhiza/rendered actor pages and index.md from the run's agent actor records, the same systemic render staleness the passed concepts-model-voice leaf had, not from the docs change.
